newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Nabisco Holdings upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Nabisco Holdings upgraded.

text.p: BT Securities analyst John O'Neil said Tuesday he upgraded his rating on Nabisco Holdings Corp to a buy from market performer.
-- On Monday, Nabisco reported net income for the second quarter of $0.38 a share, up from $0.34 a year ago, excluding restructuring expenses.

-- "Yesterday's earnings release showed the success in the company's restructuring program and a turnaround in the cookie and category category where they are now driving profitable volume growth," O'Neil said.

-- His earnings estimates remain $1.60 a share for 1997 and $1.85 for 1998. His 12-month price target is $50 a share based on 10.5 times earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization.
